Question 1
?

Which of the following is equivalent to ∫C(2−y2)ds, where C is the ellipse 2x2+18y2=36, traversed once in the counterclockwise direction?

a
∫02πcos2⁡t2sin2⁡t+16dt
b
2∫02πsin2⁡t16sin2⁡t+2dt
c
2∫02πcos2⁡t16sin2⁡t+2dt
d
2∫02πcos2⁡t2sin2⁡t+16dt
e
∫02πsin2⁡t16sin2⁡t+2dt
